rows.text_1_facilitator::eng: Learning how to solve problems with your child is important. 🔄 Let’s explore how today!
rows.text_2::eng:
❗ Learning how to solve problems with your child can help you avoid having to use consequences. 

🌱 As children get older, they will be able to work through their problems by themselves more often. 

💡 This builds important skills that will benefit them for life! 😃

rows.text_1_facilitator::eng: @data.characters.f3_son_7.name’s mother, @data.characters.f3_mother.name is concerned that @data.characters.f3_son_7.name is sleeping late everyday because of unfinished homework. Let’s see how they try to solve the problem together:
rows.character_1_text::eng: @data.characters.f3_mother.name: Come on, @data.characters.f3_son_7.name, it's time to get ready for bed.
rows.character_2_text::eng: But I still have so much homework to do!
rows.character_3_text::eng: Hm, this is the third night in a row that you haven't got to bed on time because of homework.

rows.character_1_text::eng: How can we make sure you get all your work done and still get to bed on time?
rows.character_3_text::eng: How about we make a rule that you start your homework half an hour after you get home from school. That way, you can finish it and have some time to relax before bed, too! I am happy to help you a little bit.

rows.character_1_text::eng: @data.characters.f3_son_7.name, have you started your homework yet?
rows.character_2_text::eng: I'll start now, Mummy! Can I talk to you about this question?

rows.character_1_text::eng: Look, Mummy, I'm ready for bed so early tonight!
rows.character_3_id: Well done, @data.characters.f3_son_7.name. Thank you for working with me to find a solution that works. Now you can be well-rested for tomorrow!

rows.text_1_facilitator::eng:
When something happens, take a deep breath. 

4️⃣ Then, help your child work on the problem with these four steps:

rows.section_1_text::eng:
💡 Put the problem into words.
👂 Talk to your child about what the problem is.
rows.section_2_text::eng:
📝 Together, think of possible solutions to this problem.
✨ What could you or your child do differently in this situation in the future?
rows.section_3_text::eng:
⭐ Choose one solution together.
🔑 Try it next time you are in a similar situation.
rows.section_4_text::eng:
✅ Ask yourself, “Did it work?” 
😃 If yes, great!
😔 If not, talk to your child about trying another solution next time.

rows.quiz_1_question::eng: Are you ready for a home activity? ⭐ Today, talk with your child about the four steps to problem solving: Know It, Solve It, Try It, Test It. Knowing how to solve problems is something they can use for the rest of their lives! Can you do it today?
rows.quiz_1_feedback_2::eng: That’s okay. Try to review these steps together sometime this week.
